scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply gefi --config ./wrangler.toml --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply gefi --config ./wrangler.toml --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: tsx scripts/seed.ts | wrangler d1 execute gefi --config ./wrangler.toml --local --file=/dev/stdin
scripts.db:seed:staging: tsx scripts/seed.ts | wrangler d1 execute gefi --config ./wrangler.toml --env staging --remote --file=/dev/stdin
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute gefi --config ./wrangler.toml --local --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS model_versions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS models; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS categories; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS _migrations; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS d1_migrations;" && pnpm run db:migrate:local
